selection.rule: large when the live safe rectangle is at least large_min_safe_width by large_min_safe_height points; otherwise compact. Insets come from the window safe area. A named phone with an unknown outer screen and a larger inner screen changes class only when that rectangle changes.

size_classes.compact: Lower grip for a short or narrow safe rectangle, including an unknown outer screen.
size_classes.large: Raised side grip when the safe rectangle is tablet-like, including an unknown inner screen. Width of at least 1000 points also applies the existing wide scale.

saved_layout_keys.legacy_read: HaloPad.phone.v3 or HaloPad.tablet.v3 is read only when the size class still matches that idiom. Writes and resets use v4.
